title: Twincity Marathon 2027 Review: Cyberjaya's Multi-Distance Road Race Returns
seo_title: Twincity Marathon 2027 Review | Cyberjaya Malaysia Race Guide
meta_description: The Twincity Marathon 2027 is set for January 24 in Cyberjaya, Selangor, Malaysia. Four distances from 5K to full marathon in Malaysia's Silicon Valley — here's what to expect.
dek: Set for 24 January 2027 in Cyberjaya — Malaysia's purpose-built tech city south of Kuala Lumpur — the Twincity Marathon offers four distances from 5K to the full 42.195km. Registration isn't open yet, but the venue and date are locked in. Here's the early intelligence.
verdict: The Twincity Marathon 2027 is a well-structured Malaysian road race in a distinctive setting: Cyberjaya, the planned tech hub that forms one half of the 'twin city' pairing with neighbouring Putrajaya (Malaysia's administrative capital). Four distances — full marathon, half marathon, 12km, and 5km — make it genuinely inclusive across abilities, and the wide, well-maintained roads of a planned city provide a course that's likely to be flat, fast, and free of the traffic conflicts that plague city-centre races. The January date catches Malaysia's relatively dry northeast monsoon period on the west coast. Registration details aren't available yet, but the multi-distance format and the unique twin-city setting make this worth tracking.

sections.heading: The Venue: Cyberjaya, Malaysia's Silicon Valley
paragraphs: Cyberjaya is Malaysia's flagship tech city — a planned urban centre roughly 30km south of Kuala Lumpur, designed with wide boulevards, green spaces, and a road network built for efficiency rather than heritage preservation. [1] For a marathon, that's an asset: wide roads with dedicated lanes, minimal tight turns, modern infrastructure, and a city layout that doesn't require the complex traffic management of a historic urban core.

The 'Twincity' name refers to Cyberjaya's pairing with Putrajaya, the federal administrative capital directly adjacent. While the race is anchored in Cyberjaya, the twin-city concept suggests the course may cross into or skirt Putrajaya's iconic boulevards and lakefront precinct — one of Malaysia's most photogenic running corridors.

sections.heading: The Distances: Four Options, Full Marathon as Headliner
paragraphs: Four distances are offered: a full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21.098km), 12km, and 5km. [1] The 12km is an unusual middle distance — between the 10K and half marathon — which gives runners a stepping-stone option for those building toward longer races.

The full marathon is the primary distance, positioning this as a serious road race rather than a fun-run festival. The wide-road, purpose-built-city setting should make for a fast, rhythm-friendly course with minimal congestion after the opening kilometres.

sections.heading: The Date and Logistics
paragraphs: 24 January falls within Malaysia's northeast monsoon season, but Cyberjaya sits on the west coast of Peninsular Malaysia, which is largely sheltered from the heavy rains that affect the east coast from November through March. [1] January in the Klang Valley is typically warm and humid with occasional afternoon thunderstorms — a pre-dawn start is standard and should be expected.

Getting to Cyberjaya is straightforward: it's a 30–40 minute drive from central KL via the MEX Highway, or accessible by MRT Putrajaya Line (Putrajaya Sentral station, then a short Grab or bus). For international runners, KLIA is roughly 20km away, making this one of Malaysia's more logistically accessible races for fly-in participants.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: The Twincity Marathon offers a distinctive proposition: a multi-distance Malaysian road race in a purpose-built city with wide roads and a twin-city setting that's unique on the calendar. The four-distance spread makes it suitable for groups with mixed abilities, and the Cyberjaya–Putrajaya corridor is one of the better road-running environments in the Klang Valley.

Registration isn't open yet, but the date and venue are confirmed. Check the AIMS calendar and Finishers.com for registration updates. The 2027 edition is set for 24 January in Cyberjaya, Sepang, Selangor, Malaysia. [1]
